defects.webhook backoff argument order: webhooks.js still calls backoffFor(attempt, backoffBaseMs) while backoffFor now takes (baseMs, attempt), so webhook retry delays are computed from swapped arguments.
defects.default base delay halved: config.js changes backoffBaseMs from 500 to 250, so default retries use a 250 ms base instead of the 500 ms the spec requires.
defects.stop does not await drain: scheduler.stop() calls queue.drain() without await, so stop() closes the store while in-flight tasks are still running.
defects.reports never removed: TaskQueue.finish() returns early for kind 'report' and never calls removeTask, so finished report tasks stay in the store.
defects.takeReady shadows now: takeReady declares const now = now(), which throws a ReferenceError (now is in its temporal dead zone), so the queue crashes and no task ever runs.

decoys.decoy Math.pow: Replacing Math.pow(2, attempt - 1) with the ** operator in backoff.js changes the retry delay for some attempts.
decoys.decoy object spread: Replacing Object.assign({}, queue.stats, ...) with object spread in scheduler.stats() drops the waiting count from the returned stats.
decoys.decoy branch reorder: Moving the retry check before the ok check in TaskQueue.execute() makes successful tasks retry, so finished tasks are never removed from the store.
